title: Whistlers Knoll

services.name: Private Events
services.desc: Whistler’s Knoll offers a refined yet relaxed setting for private events of all kinds - from milestone celebrations to corporate retreats and intimate dinners. Set among the vineyard, our spaces invite connection, conversation, and an unhurried experience away from the ordinary. Each event is hosted with intention, shaped by the season, and tailored to the people gathered. Whether you’re planning a polished evening or something more casual, our team will help you create an experience that feels thoughtful and effortless. Private events include exclusive use of designated spaces within the vineyard, with indoor and outdoor options available depending on the season and size of your group.

blurb: Vineyard Wedding & Event Venue in Hortonville, WI. Whistler’s Knoll is tucked into the countryside just outside Hortonville, Wisconsin. Our vineyard is planted with grapes selected to thrive in the Wisconsin climate. We host weddings, private events, Corporate events, live music, Chef’s dinners and more.
